patterns.name: Singleton Manager
patterns.description: MonoBehaviour singleton with DontDestroyOnLoad for SDK managers
patterns.template: private static T _instance; public static T Instance => _instance; void Awake() { if (_instance != null) { Destroy(gameObject); return; } _instance = this as T; DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject); }
